title: row
description: One line of `cpa setup check --json` (JSON Lines, docs/27 §2.6): one setup row of this Mac. Unknown fields are always allowed; id, state and fix[].op are extensible enums (x-knownValues): show an unknown one as it is, offer no button for an unknown op. Never carries host_id, a USB serial or dev (check_setup.py rejects those keys anywhere). Only keywords the WhisperWoof validator knows are used.

state.description: ok done; act needs a click; wait waits for something outside (the device); warn works but should change; off not set up (optional rows); skip you said no; na does not apply here; err broken.

required.description: Counted in 'N steps left' (docs/27 §2.3); cpa setup check --quiet exits 0 only when every required row is ok.

blocked_by.description: Rows that must be ok before this row's buttons work (the device row waits for service and notes).

title.description: One line for a person, display_safe: no C0, DEL, C1, line or paragraph separators, bidirectional controls or lone surrogates.

detail.description: May be empty. display_safe: no C0, DEL, C1, line or paragraph separators, bidirectional controls or lone surrogates.

fix.description: Buttons, in order. The app builds the argv from op with its own verb table and checks every argument; it never runs a string from the row.

service.install: cpa service install. hooks.install: cpa hooks install (shows the change; --yes writes). host.name: cpa host name -- NAME. stt.setup: cpa-stt setup. Reserved for docs/27 O2-O6: notes.dir, device.bind, device.forget, settings.import, setup.skip.

cand.description: device.bind: the one-off candidate cpad gave (docs/27 §3.1), never a serial.
